user.title: Configure HA Voice Label Sync

new.title: Create a new configuration
new.description:
HVLS creates a new file only after approval in Preview. After setup, open **HA Voice Label Sync** from the sidebar or choose **Visit** on the integration device page; entity selection will open directly.

{diagnostic}

data_description.backup_retention: Maximum number of previous generated files to retain. Use 0 to disable retention.
data_description.create_backup: A backup is made before any later replacement approved in Preview. Installation never overwrites the existing file.

existing.title: Reuse an existing configuration
existing.description:
Your existing YAML will remain unchanged. After saving, finish Home Assistant's standard setup screens (name and area), then open **HA Voice Label Sync** from the sidebar or choose **Visit** on the integration device page. The panel will guide you directly to the Assistant.

{diagnostic}
